origin.details: The series is the first 400 rows of ttrc, except adjRatios, naCheck, getYahooData, and stockSymbols.
origin.example: cat(sprintf("%.8f\n", tail(na.omit(as.numeric(adjRatios(xts(c(NA,NA,2,NA,NA), ix), xts(c(NA,0.1,NA,NA,NA), ix), xts(rep(10,5), ix)))), 1)))

translation.details: Numeric inputs follow TTR's matrix path. A univariate result is a one-dimensional array. Several columns are a Frame.

finite = [v for v in flat(adjRatios([float('nan'), float('nan'), 2.0, float('nan'), float('nan')], [float('nan'), 0.1, float('nan'), float('nan'), float('nan')], [10.0]*5)) if v is not None]
